external_collaboration.evidence_quote: 5th Year Business students participated in an Erasmus exchange with Fyllingsdalen vgs. Secondary School in Bergen, Norway. They attended school in Bergen from the 11th -17th of March. They completed a study on Fast Fashion and Sustainability with Norwegian students who hosted them. They visited historical sights , went on a fjord Cruise and experienced many aspects of Norwegian culture. A memorable experience for all involved. We now welcome the a return visit of Norwegian students to our school

During the week of Oct 7th John Scottus families hosted 18 students from Latvia, Italy and the Netherlands visiting the school as part of the Erasmus project on Human Rights and Responsibilities. It was a week of great enthusiasm and endeavour from students who produced fantastic videos on various aspects of Human Rights. Special thanks must be given to all the teachers involved in organising the event, namely Ms. Shanahan, Ms. Sweeney and Mr. Bourke.
